title: CTA Group Allentown
description: An optional, collapsible group of up to two actions. Each action has its own Button Allentown style, label, and a Content, URL, or Form target. Form targets use the same HubSpot embed code as Form Section and open from the CTA button.

buttons.description: Add zero, one or two actions. Set each action’s style, label, and Content, URL, or Form target. A Form target opens its HubSpot embed code in a modal.
